coverage.moneyExplanation: DOJ registry lists foreign principals, agents and filing PDFs. It does not provide standardized payments or lobbying spending totals; no amount has been attributed without a reviewed original financial disclosure.
coverage.principalScope: FARA foreign principals include governments, companies, organizations and individuals. A registration alone does not establish government ownership.
coverage.activityScope: Descriptions of lobbying, communications, policy targets and services remain in original filings until extracted and verified.
coverage.recordScope: All active and terminated principals in this DOJ bulk snapshot, not all possible foreign lobbying activities.
